name: Garrick's Head
summary: At Northshire's vineyards, Garrick Padfoot's severed head proves the cutthroat is dead. The authorities at Northshire Abbey require it before they pay the bounty.

sections.title: A Bandit's End
sections.body: For weeks, Garrick Padfoot and his gang harassed Northshire Valley's farmers and merchants. Stormwind's defenses were stretched thin, and local guards were busy with kobolds and Defias bandits. So Garrick hid in a shack near the vineyards and raided passing trade. Deputy Willem offered a bounty for the outlaw's death, seeking someone to kill him and bring back proof.

faq.answer: Garrick Padfoot was a cutthroat who terrorized Northshire Valley's farmers, vineyard workers, and traveling merchants. He set up an outpost with his gang east of Northshire Abbey, across the river.

faq.q: Why is a severed head needed to collect the bounty?
faq.answer: Deputy Willem and the Northshire authorities require proof of Garrick's death before paying the bounty.
Padfoot hid in a small wooden shack east of Northshire Abbey, across the river bridge near the Northshire vineyards.

faq.q: Who pays the bounty for Garrick's head?
faq.answer: Deputy Willem posted the bounty and pays it when he receives Garrick's head. He is stationed just outside Northshire Abbey's entrance.

angles.text: As a human, taking Padfoot's head strikes an early blow against the lawlessness spreading through Elwynn Forest.
As a rogue, eliminating Padfoot shows local ruffians that banditry meets deadly, professional blades.
